title: Your HOA Is Hiding a $404K Secret Tax
hook: Your dream home's listing price left out one number — and that missing HOA fee has a $404,000 price tag nobody showed you.
angle: The true 30-year opportunity cost of HOA fees vs. investing that money — a number real estate agents never put in the listing
audience: Homebuyers and current owners in HOA communities who focus on the mortgage and ignore the full lifetime cost of HOA fees
key_numbers: $330/month invested at 7% for 30 years = $404,000 in lost growth
